schema_identity_and_lifecycle.outcome: Accepted two-table task_stage_attempts/task_stage_attempt_events model, required identity fields, seven-state lifecycle vocabulary, inspection-only indexes, and human-admin-session debug write boundary.

flag_off_runtime_isolation_and_debug_rea.outcome: Accepted table-blind runtime path list, compact flag-off debug read payload, workspace masking/auth rules, typed default-off flag registry entry, and static guardrails.

runs_relationship_and_archive_semantics.outcome: Accepted soft nullable run link, compact read-time run summary, archived status/timestamp/event semantics, child-first rollback, and trusted proxy-auth human-admin rule.

api_ui_surface_and_spec_013b_boundary.outcome: Accepted dedicated task-scoped read route, compact task-detail section, controlled fixture/UAT endpoint conditions, explicit no-control-plane contract, and task_stage_attempts.v1 envelope.

consensus.item: Debug write boundary for create/update/archive lifecycle records
consensus.outcome: Accepted with conditions: human-admin session guard for runtime debug writes, authenticated read-only operator inspection, lifecycle append/update only as observed-state recording, no execution-control authority.

consensus.session: Flag-Off Runtime Isolation And Debug Reads
consensus.item: Auth and workspace masking rules for attempt inspection and debug writes
consensus.outcome: Accepted with caveat: read path follows existing viewer-or-higher workspace masking and masked task-not-found behavior; debug writes require verified human-admin context excluding API-key and agent-key callers; Plan must confirm trusted proxy-auth treatment.

consensus.item: Trusted proxy-auth admin handling for debug writes
consensus.outcome: Accepted with conditions: trusted proxy-auth admins count only as real positive-id human admins; global API-key, agent API-key, and agent-identity requests never satisfy the debug-write guard.

Accepted with conditions: at most one spec-scoped fixture/UAT endpoint, human-admin-only, mutation/rate limited, CSRF-protected for cookie auth, structured-audited, unavailable outside fixture/UAT unless explicitly reviewed, and inert beyond attempt/event/audit rows.
Accepted with precision: encode explicit forbidden schema/field/helper/UI/action controls; released and cancelled remain passive observed states only.

FEATURE_TASK_CONTROL_PLANE typed default-off registry entry using resolveFlag.
